tokens.name: felt
tokens.usage: The table. Background of every game screen; never used for app chrome or menus.

tokens.name: felt-deep
tokens.usage: Recessed felt: the fill of empty card slots and the game bar that sits on the table.

tokens.name: felt-line
tokens.usage: Outline of empty slots and the suit watermark inside a foundation slot. 3.6:1 on felt, 4.8:1 on felt-deep.

tokens.name: on-felt
tokens.usage: Text and icons on felt or felt-deep: move counter, timer, game title on the table.

tokens.name: on-felt-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text on felt: stat labels, slot captions (5:1 light, 6.5:1 dark).

tokens.name: card-face
tokens.usage: Face-up card stock. Slightly dimmed at night so a full tableau doesn't glare.

tokens.name: card-edge
tokens.usage: 1px hairline around a card face; separates overlapping cards in a fan. Decorative, never the only boundary (card-face on felt is 7:1).

tokens.name: suit-red
tokens.usage: Hearts and diamonds: index, pips and face-card letter on card-face (6.1:1 light, 5.6:1 dark).

tokens.name: suit-black
tokens.usage: Spades and clubs on card-face. Same in both themes because card-face stays light.

tokens.name: suit-red-chrome
tokens.usage: Hearts and diamonds shown outside a card, on surface or surface-raised (6.5:1 light, 4.7:1+ dark). Black suits outside a card use ink.

tokens.name: suit-blue
tokens.usage: Four-color deck only: diamonds, on card-face (6.4:1 light, 5.3:1 dark).

tokens.name: suit-green
tokens.usage: Four-color deck only: clubs, on card-face (7.8:1 light, 6.5:1 dark). Darker than suit-red so the two differ in lightness, not hue alone.

tokens.name: card-back
tokens.usage: Oxblood card back. Always framed by a card-face margin so it reads against felt.

tokens.name: card-back-line
tokens.usage: The lattice drawn on card-back. Decorative only.

tokens.name: brass
tokens.usage: The one accent: selected-card ring, primary button, win state. 3.8:1 on felt as a ring; never as text on cream.

tokens.name: on-brass
tokens.usage: Text on a brass fill (primary button label), 7:1+.

tokens.name: hint
tokens.usage: Hint and legal-drop glow on felt. Blue so it never competes with red suits or brass selection.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: App chrome: the suite launcher, menus, settings and dialogs.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Cards in the launcher (game tiles), popovers, dialogs on surface.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text on surface and surface-raised (14:1+).

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text on surface and surface-raised: stats, captions (5.7:1+).

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Control borders on surface: quiet buttons, inputs, tile outlines (3.4:1 light, 3.5:1 dark).

tokens.name: hairline
tokens.usage: Dividers and list rules in chrome. Decorative — never the only edge of a control.

tokens.name: focus-felt
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus ring for anything on the table (5.4:1 on felt).

tokens.name: focus-chrome
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus ring for anything on surface.

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: Backdrop behind dialogs and sheets (rules, settings, win). Dims the table without hiding it.

styles.name: suite-title
styles.usage: The suite name in the launcher header. Once per screen.

styles.name: game-title
styles.usage: A game's name on its tile and on the table's game bar.

styles.name: card-index
styles.usage: Rank in a card's corner at the default 72×100 size. Scales with card-width (≈0.28×).

styles.name: card-court
styles.usage: The large letter at the centre of J, Q and K.

styles.name: button
styles.usage: Button labels. Sentence case, verb first.

styles.name: stat
styles.usage: Timer, move count, score. Set font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums so digits don't jitter.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Uppercase label above a stat, and slot captions. The only uppercase text in the system.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Secondary lines on tiles: best time, win rate.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Inside a card: index inset, gap between rank and suit.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between adjacent slots and between tableau columns at compact width.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Gap between tableau columns at default width; button inline padding.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Tile padding, game bar padding.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Between the top row (cells, foundations) and the tableau; launcher grid gap.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Page margins in the launcher.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Chips, small badges.

tokens.name: radius-card
tokens.usage: Every card and card slot at 72px wide (≈8% of card-width when scaled).

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, game tiles, the game bar.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Dialogs and sheets (the win dialog, settings).

card.note: Card geometry. Cards keep the poker ratio 5:7; scale card-width and derive the rest.

tokens.name: card-width
tokens.usage: Default card width on a desktop table. Scale between 44px (phone) and 112px (large screen).

tokens.name: card-height
tokens.usage: card-width × 1.4 (rounded).

tokens.name: card-fan
tokens.usage: Vertical offset between face-up cards in a tableau column — enough to show the index.

tokens.name: card-fan-down
tokens.usage: Vertical offset between face-down cards (Klondike, Spider).

tokens.name: shadow-card
tokens.usage: Every card at rest on the felt.

tokens.name: shadow-lift
tokens.usage: A card or run being dragged or animating to a pile.

tokens.name: shadow-panel
tokens.usage: Game tiles and dialogs in chrome.

layout.note: Sizes that keep the suite usable on every device.

tokens.name: tap-min
tokens.usage: Minimum touch target on coarse pointers: buttons, toggles, segmented options, close buttons.

tokens.name: sheet-max
tokens.usage: Maximum width of a dialog or sheet. Below 520px viewport width sheets become bottom sheets.

tokens.name: card-min
tokens.usage: Smallest card width the FreeCell table will scale down to (a 320px-wide phone).

tokens.name: card-max
tokens.usage: Largest card width on big screens. The Card size setting lowers this cap.
